name: Lattice Core
desc: A crystalline resonator grown through the hull. It builds Resonance (0-100) from damage absorbed by shields and from this ship's hits on enemy hull and armor, and loses it slowly out of combat contact. At %s Resonance or more the core is in Overtone: the next ship-system use is empowered and spends %s Resonance. Lattice ships within %s units share %s of the Resonance they gain. The core's seams glow brighter with Resonance. Incompatible with Safety Overrides.
short: A crystalline resonator grown through the hull.

name: Conductor's Bridge
desc: Lattice allies within %s units receive %s Sympathy from this ship instead of the usual share, and gain %s Resonance per second while in range.
short: Lattice allies within %s units receive %s Sympathy from this ship instead of the usual share, and gain %s Resonance per second while in range.

name: Fracture
desc: Hits from this ship's weapons on enemy hull or armor add a Fracture stack to the target (up to %s; stacks fade after %s without a new hit). The hit that would add a %s stack shatters the plating instead: %s bonus damage to armor at the impact point, and the stacks reset.
short: Hits from this ship's weapons on enemy hull or armor add a Fracture stack to the target (up to %s; stacks fade after %s without a new hit).

name: Stolen Time
desc: Hull and armor damage this ship deals to enemy ships steals combat readiness: about %s CR per %s damage (scaled by target size), which the target loses and this ship gains. At most %s can be taken from any one ship. On the Virtuoso, CR stolen while already at 100% extends peak performance time instead (%s per 1%%). Half as effective when not piloted by the player.
short: Hull and armor damage this ship deals to enemy ships steals combat readiness: about %s CR per %s damage (scaled by target size), which the target loses and this ship gains.

name: Bravura
desc: At %s combat readiness the Virtuoso enters Bravura until its CR drops below %s: +%s top speed and maneuverability, +%s flux dissipation, +%s energy weapon rate of fire, %s faster system recharge, and the Sforzando lances are always Accented. The seams burn gold-white. Locked on the Unsung.
short: At %s combat readiness the Virtuoso enters Bravura until its CR drops below %s: +%s top speed and maneuverability, +%s flux dissipation, +%s energy weapon rate of fire, %s faster system recharge, and the Sforzando lances are always Accented.

name: Unbound Core
desc: The Virtuoso's core can drop its safety tuning, as Safety Overrides does for lesser hulls: +%s top speed, flux dissipation multiplied by %s, the zero-flux boost at any flux level and no active venting; peak performance time is cut to a third and weapons lose range beyond %s. Stolen Time pays the readiness back. Only the full Virtuoso can install it.
short: The Virtuoso's core can drop its safety tuning, as Safety Overrides does for lesser hulls: +%s top speed, flux dissipation multiplied by %s, the zero-flux boost at any flux level and no active venting; peak performance time is cut to a third and weapons lose range beyond %s.

name: Phase-Locked Petals
desc: When a petal of the array is destroyed, its stored Resonance floods the core and the surviving petals, which jump straight into Overtone and gain %s weapon damage for the rest of the battle.
short: When a petal of the array is destroyed, its stored Resonance floods the core and the surviving petals, which jump straight into Overtone and gain %s weapon damage for the rest of the battle.

name: Tuned Wings
desc: Fighters within %s units of the ship are tuned to its ring: fighter replacement rate is %s faster while any of its wings fight inside the zone.
